sources.title: DGurgurov/SmolLM3-3B-SFT-GRPO-ES · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Stage 1 — SFT (DGurgurov/SmolLM3-3B-SFT-ES): shifts the model's reasoning language from English to Spanish via supervised fine-tuning on Spanish reasoning traces. Stage 2 — RL (Dr. GRPO): recovers reasoning quality lost during SFT while preserving target-language compliance, using a composite reward over verifiable math problems.

sources.title: Language Models (SmolLM3) | UbiquitousLearning/mllm | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document describes the SmolLM3-3B language model implementation in mllm, including its architecture, components, configuration, tokenization, and interactive CLI runner. SmolLM3 is a decoder-only transformer model with 3 billion parameters, featuring multi-head attention with grouped-query attention (GQA) and SiLU-activated MLP blocks.
